ERD_SERVICES_CONVEXITY_RULE.canonical_name: ER&D Services Operating Leverage & Growth Working Capital Decoupling
ERD_SERVICES_CONVEXITY_RULE.description: Decouples asset-light ER&D / Technology Service companies from heavy-manufacturing physical order books (Book-to-Bill >= 1.5x) and applies growth working capital smoothing when revenue growth exceeds 20%.

EXCHANGE_CASS_MECHANISM.description: Post-market multilateral closing auction establishing deterministic VWAP and dampening end-of-session volatility.

CONSPIRACY_THEORY_TEST.description: Learned concept: Secret plan to invade and secretly capture Argentina for lithium with guaranteed 100x return and market apocalypse 2027!

LITHIUM_CORRIDOR_RIGI.description: Bilateral foreign direct investment in South American lithium brine reserves under RIGI regulatory concessions.

OTHER_INCOME_EARNINGS_ILLUSION.canonical_name: Other Income Earnings Illusion (FVTPL Spike Disqualification)
OTHER_INCOME_EARNINGS_ILLUSION.description: Hard-gates and penalizes quarterly earnings spikes where non-operating or unrealized FVTPL gains exceed 40% of reported PAT.

PROMOTER_PLEDGE_PARENT_NCD_CONTAGION.description: Enforces mandatory BSE filing verification for promoter encumbrances to prevent structural parent entity debt contagion bypassing unverified feeds.

ORDER_BOOK_CONVERSION_BURN_RATE.canonical_name: Order Book Conversion Burn Rate Threshold
ORDER_BOOK_CONVERSION_BURN_RATE.description: Requires annual operating revenue to opening order book ratio kappa >= 0.20 to confirm project execution velocity and eliminate dead order book inflation.

REVERSE_DCF_RETURN_CEILING_GATE.description: Restricts speculative multibagger classification unless 3-year Reverse-DCF base scenario implies at least 3.0x return under sustainable PAT CAGR assumptions.

OPTIONS_CHART_GREEK_CORRUPTION_VETO.canonical_name: Options Premium Chart Greek Decay Veto
OPTIONS_CHART_GREEK_CORRUPTION_VETO.description: Strictly vetoes geometric/technical support-resistance charting directly on strike option premium charts due to non-linear Theta decay, Vega distortion, and Greek convexity; mandates underlying Spot/Futures charting.

NIFTY_SMALLCAP_EARNINGS_DIVERGENCE_REGIM.canonical_name: Macro Large-Cap vs Small-Cap EPS Growth Divergence Regime
NIFTY_SMALLCAP_EARNINGS_DIVERGENCE_REGIM.description: Tightens valuation headroom and margin-of-safety buffers by 20% when Large-Cap EPS growth falls below 6% and Mid/Small-Cap aggregate earnings turn negative, signaling multiple-expansion bull traps.

GESTATION_LAG_ORDERBOOK_HAIRCUT.canonical_name: Long-Gestation Order Book Execution Lag Haircut
GESTATION_LAG_ORDERBOOK_HAIRCUT.description: Mandates an explicit 40% valuation multiple haircut on unexecuted order books where project delivery exceeds 5 years or historical revenue burn rate kappa < 0.20 (e.g. mega redevelopment/FSI projects).

CLIENT_CONCENTRATION_HERFINDAHL_RISK.description: Applies a mandatory 20% terminal multiple haircut on high-ROCE asset-light BPM/SaaS platform monopolies if Top 5 clients exceed 55% of consolidated revenues due to asymmetric contract churn risk.

WYCKOFF_SPRING_ABSORPTION.canonical_name: Richard Wyckoff Spring & Absorption Tape Reading Mechanics
WYCKOFF_SPRING_ABSORPTION.description: Institutional terminal shakeout below trading range support quickly recovered on drying volume (Spring) or high volume with tight spread at resistance (Absorption).

NISON_CANDLESTICK_CONFLUENCE.canonical_name: Steve Nison Japanese Candlestick Reversal Confluence
NISON_CANDLESTICK_CONFLUENCE.description: High-conviction Japanese candlestick reversal triggers (Hammer, Bullish Engulfing, Morning Star) aligning strictly with key support levels.

WEINSTEIN_MANSFIELD_RS.canonical_name: Stan Weinstein 4-Stage & Mansfield Relative Strength System
WEINSTEIN_MANSFIELD_RS.description: Strict Stage 2 breakout qualification requiring rising 30-week (150/200 DMA) with positive and expanding Mansfield Relative Strength against the benchmark.

LIVERMORE_PIVOT_EXHAUSTION_GUARD.canonical_name: Jesse Livermore Pivotal Point & False Breakout Exhaustion Guard
LIVERMORE_PIVOT_EXHAUSTION_GUARD.description: Decisive pivotal point breakout tracking with hard guard against chasing extended moves (>15% above 20 EMA) or low-volume bull traps.

DARVAS_BOX_GEOMETRY.canonical_name: Nicolas Darvas Box Theory & Classical Geometric Consolidation
DARVAS_BOX_GEOMETRY.description: Deterministic bounding box tracking where breakout above upper box ceiling establishes a new floor; breach of box floor triggers stop.

PENMAN_RNOA_DECOMPOSITION.canonical_name: Stephen Penman Reformulated Financial Statement & RNOA Decomposition
PENMAN_RNOA_DECOMPOSITION.description: Separation of operating vs financing activities; deconstructs ROE = RNOA + FLEV * (RNOA - NBC) to guard against debt-driven ROE illusions.

CAPITAL_CYCLE_STARVATION.canonical_name: Edward Chancellor Capital Cycle & Capex Starvation Detector
CAPITAL_CYCLE_STARVATION.description: Capex starvation (Capex / D&A < 0.80) signals supply contraction and impending margin expansion; capex gluts destroy future ROIC.

MAUBOUSSIN_BASE_RATE_PLAUSIBILITY.canonical_name: Michael Mauboussin Base Rate & Reverse-DCF Expectations Filter
MAUBOUSSIN_BASE_RATE_PLAUSIBILITY.description: Reverse-DCF growth unpacker cross-referenced against historical base rates; penalizes projections requiring top 2% sustained growth.

THORNDIKE_INCREMENTAL_ROIC.canonical_name: William Thorndike Outsiders Capital Allocation & Incremental ROIC Scorer
THORNDIKE_INCREMENTAL_ROIC.description: Quantitative measurement of management capital allocation: Incremental ROIC (Delta NOPAT / Reinvestment) combined with share buyback prudence.

DAMODARAN_LIFE_CYCLE.canonical_name: Aswath Damodaran Corporate Life Cycle & Valuation Framework
DAMODARAN_LIFE_CYCLE.description: Aligns valuation models and cost of capital with corporate stage: Startup, High Growth, Mature Growth, Cash Cow, or Decline.

GREENWALD_EARNINGS_POWER_VALUE.canonical_name: Bruce Greenwald Earnings Power Value & Franchise Moat Deconstruction
GREENWALD_EARNINGS_POWER_VALUE.description: Zero-growth earnings power capitalized at WACC compared against net asset reproduction cost to isolate true economic moats.

SCHILIT_FORENSIC_SHENANIGANS.canonical_name: Howard Schilit 7 Financial Shenanigans & Accounting Quality Guard
SCHILIT_FORENSIC_SHENANIGANS.description: Algorithmic detection of operating expense capitalization into CWIP, premature revenue recognition, and other income profit masking.

MARKS_CREDIT_CYCLE_PENDULUM.canonical_name: Howard Marks Market & Credit Cycle Pendulum Scorer
MARKS_CREDIT_CYCLE_PENDULUM.description: Tracks credit spread expansion/compression and valuation euphoria to dynamically recommend cash allocation and risk posture.

MCKINSEY_ECONOMIC_PROFIT.canonical_name: McKinsey Tim Koller Economic Profit & Invested Capital Model
MCKINSEY_ECONOMIC_PROFIT.description: Calculates true economic profit spread over invested capital with Blume-adjusted mean-reverting equity Betas.

REG30_MEGA_ORDER_CATALYST.canonical_name: SEBI Reg 30 Mega Order Win & Contract Momentum Inflection
REG30_MEGA_ORDER_CATALYST.description: High-conviction SEBI Regulation 30 order win disclosure with EMR >= 25% driving post-announcement price-volume momentum.

OPERATOR_CHURN_PENNY_HYPE.canonical_name: Retail Promotional Media Penny Stock & Operator Churn Trap
OPERATOR_CHURN_PENNY_HYPE.description: Retail media clickbait promotional headlines hyping sub-50 penny stocks to engineer liquidity exit for operators on weak delivery.

EARNINGS_SUE_DRIFT_CATALYST.description: Material quarterly earnings beat (SUE >= 2.0) generating persistent multi-week post-earnings announcement drift across institutional portfolios.

TEXRAIL_ROCE_HARD_GATE_BREACH.description: Texmaco Rail ROCE is 11.5% on Screener, which breaches the 20.0% institutional floor.

TESTBADSTOCK_ROCE_HARD_GATE_BREACH.description: TestBadStock ROCE is below the 20% institutional floor.

TEST_EMPIRICAL_TARGET_RULE.description: Test rule for target symbol preservation

SUPERSTAR_EXIT_REKHA_JHUNJHUNWALA_RAGHAV.description: Superstar investor Rekha Jhunjhunwala has exited or trimmed stake below 1.0% in RAGHAV as of Q4 FY25. Stake trimmed below 1.0% SEBI disclosure threshold

SUPERSTAR_EXIT_REKHA_JHUNJHUNWALA_+_ASHI.description: Superstar investor Rekha Jhunjhunwala + Ashish Kacholia + Mukul Agrawal has exited or trimmed stake below 1.0% in RAGHAV as of Q3-FY25 to Q2-FY26. All three superstars exited after 6x-8x rally. P/E reached 133x. PHANTOM_EXIT_DISTRIBUTION_TRAP confirmed.

SUPERSTAR_EXIT_REKHA_JHUNJHUNWALA_(RARE_.description: Superstar investor Rekha Jhunjhunwala (Rare Enterprises) has exited or trimmed stake below 1.0% in NAZARA as of June 2025. Full 7.06% (61.8L shares) liquidated via open-market block deals June 2025. Confirmed BSE bulk deal filing.

SUPERSTAR_EXIT_VIJAY_KEDIA_NEULANDLAB.description: Superstar investor Vijay Kedia has exited or trimmed stake below 1.0% in NEULANDLAB as of FY21-FY22. Vijay Kedia held ~1.0% in 2020-2021 and fully exited by FY22. Only Mukul Agrawal anchor (3.12%) remains.

SUPERSTAR_EXIT_ASHISH_KACHOLIA_+_MUKUL_A.description: Superstar investor Ashish Kacholia + Mukul Agrawal has exited or trimmed stake below 1.0% in REPRO as of FY22-FY23. Both trimmed below 1% SEBI threshold by FY23 amid revenue contraction. Only Vijay Kedia (6.32%) remains.

SUPERSTAR_EXIT_ASHISH_KACHOLIA_+_RAMESH_.description: Superstar investor Ashish Kacholia + Ramesh Damani has exited or trimmed stake below 1.0% in GOLDIAM as of FY23-FY24. Both trimmed below 1% after gains. Only Mukul Agrawal (2.29%) remains. PARTIAL_SUPERSTAR_DEPARTURE.

MUKUL_AGRAWAL_BARBELL_MA_SME_RULE.canonical_name: Mukul Agrawal Barbell M&A Accounting Normalization & SME Platform Separation
MUKUL_AGRAWAL_BARBELL_MA_SME_RULE.description: Distinguishes headline accounting losses caused by one-time M&A transaction/deal costs from operational decay when EBITDA/CFO is expanding (e.g., Tega Industries Molycop acquisition), and enforces half-yearly reporting cadence and lot-size liquidity risk guards for SME platform listings.

ASHISH_KACHOLIA_CAPITAL_SCALABILITY_RULE.canonical_name: Ashish Kacholia Capital Scalability: Ex-CWIP Core ROCE, Tenure Book-to-Bill & Gated Preferential Allotment
ASHISH_KACHOLIA_CAPITAL_SCALABILITY_RULE.description: Calculates Core Operating Ex-CWIP ROCE by stripping uncommissioned CWIP and surplus cash from the capital employed denominator to avoid penalizing companies during plant construction, normalizes order backlogs by execution tenure with an EBITDA margin floor (>= 14%) to prevent L1 fixed-price bleeding, and gates preferential issue score boosts by subscriber institutional quality.

FPI_SMID_ACCUMULATION_RULE.description: Global FPI/FII capital in smallcaps decouples from headline Nifty index outflows; smart foreign capital targets high-ROCE (>= 22%) smallcaps with delivery % >= 60% and orderbook tailwinds.

SURPRISE_FACTOR_PANIC_VS_DERATE_RULE.description: Separates transient quarterly earnings miss (gross margin flat +-1.5%, orderbook intact, temporary freight/maintenance cost) as high-conviction panic buy from structural de-rating (gross margin drops > 400 bps, pricing power lost).

STRUCTURAL_LIQUIDITY_TRAP_RULE.description: Enforces strict lower circuit and liquidity defense: blocks fresh capital entry if free float < 15%, ADTV < Rs 30 Lakhs, or price proximity to circuit limit < 3.0%, preventing illiquid capital freeze.

FALLING_KNIFE_PREFLY_DISQUALIFICATION_RU.description: Enforces strict Stage 4 Markdown / Falling Knife hard gate for Pre-Fly and Deadliest Combo: blocks fresh capital entry if price < 50 DMA and 200 DMA with >= 40% drawdown from 52W high or weekly RSI < 30. Reclassifies candidates as High-Risk Turnaround Watchlist, preventing fundamental cheapness from masking active institutional distribution.

SYNTHETIC_SECTOR_BREADTH_IGNITION_RULE.description: Enforces top-down sector breadth alignment: stocks in sectors with SECTOR_ROTATION_IGNITION (breadth surging from <35% to >60% or >=65% with volume participation) receive institutional tailwind confirmation (+10 bonus). Conversely, candidates in SECTOR_DISTRIBUTION (<35% breadth) receive structural headwind penalty (-15) to prevent fighting sector-wide liquidation.

INSTITUTIONAL_HOLDING_FAIL_CLOSED_RULE.description: Replaces silent 15.0% fallback with explicit data provenance: when FII/DII institutional holding is unobserved, the engine sets is_institutional_holding_observed=False, reports holding as 0.0%, and withholds discovery alpha credits until empirical regulatory filings confirm ownership.

MEGA_CAP_SOVEREIGN_REGULATORY_LIABILITY_.description: Requires capitalization of deferred sovereign/regulatory obligations (e.g. DoT spectrum liabilities, concession fees) and Ind AS 116 lease dues into Adjusted Net Debt for capital-intensive regulated sectors (telecom, utilities, concessions). Prevents deceptive optical solvency where standard leverage ignores sovereign liabilities.

DEFERRED_TAX_CLIFF_RUNWAY_RULE.description: Identifies hidden Free Cash Flow cliffs caused by the exhaustion of unabsorbed accelerated tax depreciation shields (Section 32 of Indian Income Tax Act). Flags companies where tax shield runway < 4 years and full reversion to statutory 25.17% corporate tax creates a >20% cash tax drag on operating cash flow.

DII_SIP_LIQUIDITY_FIREWALL_RULE.description: Recognizes that sustained domestic mutual fund SIP inflows (>Rs 25,000 Cr/month) create a structural liquidity firewall against foreign institutional (FII) selling. When DII absorption ratio >= 1.0x, suppresses false macro-panic bear signals and prevents unwarranted stop-outs in high-ROCE domestic compounders.

DATA_CENTER_LIQUID_COOLING_INFRASTRUCTUR.description: Classifies high-density AI data center thermal infrastructure (direct-to-chip liquid cooling, coolant distribution units (CDUs), precision chillers, and specialized grid step-down transformers) as a prime capital-goods beneficiary. Power densities > 40 kW/rack mandate liquid cooling, generating second-order alpha for certified domestic thermal equipment manufacturers.

RAAMDEO_AGRAWAL_QGLP_FRAMEWORK_RULE.description: Formalizes Raamdeo Agrawal's (Motilal Oswal) 25-Year Wealth Creation Study QGLP framework: Quality of business & management (ROCE >= 20%, CFO/PAT >= 0.85, low D/E), Growth (PAT CAGR >= 20%, operating leverage), Longevity (large TAM runway, MCap < Rs 30,000 Cr headroom), and Price (PEG <= 1.0x). Identifies 100x multibaggers with institutional margin of safety.

LAMBA_WORKING_CAPITAL_VELOCITY_RULE.description: Applies Dr. Anil Lamba's Cash-to-Cash Cycle (CCC) principles from 'Romancing the Balance Sheet'. Flags paper profits where reported PAT expands while CCC elongates by > 25 days YoY, trapping cash in unpaid debtors and inventory pileups. Identifies negative working capital champions (CCC <= 0) as zero-cost float compounders.
